title: O Beloved Motherland of My Birth (Ko Ri Baieit Ba La Kha Ia Nga)
khasi_title: Ko Ri Baieit Ba La Kha Ia Nga
cultural_context: National hymn of reverence for the hills, valleys, clear watercourses, and indigenous freedoms of Meghalaya, published in 'Ki Sur Ba Dang Sawa'.
lyrics_khasi:
Ko Ri baieit ba la kha ia nga,
Mei-ri baitynnad bad ba suk,
Ki lum jong pha kiba tap da ki diengkseh,
Ki wah jong pha kiba tuid kum ka rupa;
Ha man ka kyrdon, ha man ka them,
Ka dohnud jong nga ka kynud,
Ia ka jingieit ba ngam lah ban thew
Ia pha, ko Ri baieit jong nga.

Wat la nga phet sha lyndet duriaw,
Sha ki shnong ba spah jong kiwei,
Ka mynsiem kam ju lah ban klet
Ia ki krem, ki kshaid bad ki syntiew;
Ha pha nga kwah ban im bad iap,
Ha pneh jong pha ban thiah suk,
Ko Ri u Hynniewtrep ba kyntang,
Kyrteng jong pha kan sah junom.
lyrics_english:
O beloved Motherland where I was born,
Sweet, serene, and beautiful land,
Your rolling ridges crowned with whispering pines,
Your clear waters flowing like ribbons of silver;
On every mountain ledge, in every quiet vale,
My inner spirit hums a song,
Of boundless devotion beyond measure
Unto you, my beloved Motherland.

Even should I travel far across distant oceans,
To foreign lands of glittering wealth,
My spirit could never forget
Your sacred caves, your waterfalls, and wild blossoms;
In your soil I desire to live and die,
In your embrace to repose in peace,
O hallowed land of the Seven Huts,
Your name shall endure forever.
